revisions.reason: Review 20261117 DXSDK retained-mode Viewer: creation-time WM_SIZE/WM_MOVE is restricted to hidden popups; hidden overlapped windows defer until position/show, matching WIN_NEED_SIZE. This removes early callbacks before the caller initializes its device. Existing CACA0001/32/33 frame identity, window liveness checks, stack restoration and rejected-create cleanup remain unchanged. Native API before/after counterexample, rejection negatives, hidden popup positive and position/show neighbors qualify this bounded condition; general callback ownership remains pending. Run 20261117-dxsdk-globe-viewer-paired-retained-rendering.
